doc.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Walter Page's death on the way to the show; Coleman Hawkins's last gig
summary: Bassist Walter Page died of a heart attack heading to the date, which recalls Coleman Hawkins dying while trying to reach a gig.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You mentioned the page. I thought of Walter Page . . .
. . . who was supposed to have been in the show.

Yeah. There was a recording date before the actual show. The people who taped that show off the air got the actual show. Walter was so intent on getting there during this storm. I guess he had trouble getting a cab, or whatever, but he had a heart attack and never made it. That intention reminded me of a story about Coleman Hawkins. Somebody was supposed to pick up Coleman for a gig. He came into the apartment, and Coleman was on the floor, clutching his case. He was trying to get there, even though he was so sick that he died, just before the gig.
